architectures.name: A all-in-one drama agent
architectures.protocol: HTTPS chat-style request with one uploaded photo; the agent orchestrates planning, stills, video, voice and music internally; you poll for completion and download the finished file by URL

architectures.name: B multi-tool cloud pipeline
architectures.protocol: References uploaded once via signed-URL PUT to object storage; each shot POSTed as JSON to a REST endpoint that returns an operation ID; the client polls the long-running operation (or receives a webhook), then downloads the clip by signed URL

architectures.name: C hybrid: cloud hero + local post
architectures.protocol: As B for generation (REST + long-running operation or webhook); QA analytics, grade, captions, mix and export run locally with no network, and only approved masters are uploaded to the delivery platform

architectures.name: D local open video model
architectures.protocol: Local node server on the workstation: workflow JSON queued over HTTP on localhost, progress events streamed over a WebSocket, files read and written on local disk
